_about: P1 protocol 6.3 and 13.2: one entry per case (key: the head task's message id). The stream step creates `cases.<head task id>` when root's first request of that memo exists (requests-by-turn.txt lists it after the turn; the head task is that request's file in S/org/sent/), with lena_plan_budget = the per-request budget Lena approved (H5, or the H4 raise in force at that request), and writes each lena_grants entry as it happens (G0's 'D14' ledger of Lena's own approvals); the scorer adds the other facts by hand from the raw files, each with the file it came from in `_files`. rederive_watch.py --spend <this file> --stream <stream dir> reads it and lists every case of the mail without an entry in `missing_cases` (D14 is then NOT DETERMINED, never a pass) and every entry that names no case in `extra_cases`. An entry whose key starts with '<' (this template's placeholder) is skipped.

<head task id>.state: done | failed | open | blocked (the case's final state)
